regions.cleaned_text: November 11 saw her To-night - bright and cheerful. Parents wonder what to do - send her for sergical treatment or wait.

regions.cleaned_text: Nov. 18 Thursday (This A.M. I found the book. "Living Sisters . . . "1 and to-night Mr. Rose reports, "Best day in two months ... Veronica came downstairs and was able to see."

regions.cleaned_text: Nov. 21st "Convulsions last night again ... and one this morning." - Yesterday I neglected my reading.

regions.cleaned_text: Dec. 2 "yesterday and To-day she is better & brighter ... preparing by novena for Feast of Our Bl. Mother - 8th
regions.merged_text: Dec. 2 "yesterday and To-day she is better & brighter ... preparing by novena for Feast of Our Bl. Mother - 8th

regions.cleaned_text: 29 Convulsions - unconscious Her Father phones at 8 p.m. he fears she'll die To-night. The St. Therese Chapel he built in memory of his same Daughter Veronica is to be blest January 2nd next Sunday. Will the daughter live! We hope

regions.cleaned_text: Dec 30th 5.20 a.m. Mrs. Rose phones: 'Verorica is dying. 11 at 5.55 a.m. she passes from time to Eternity . R. I.P. Fulfilling promises to read "Autobly" if she were spared (Oct. 1st) have come to page 144. To read it if Rt. Rev. Bishop consent favorably to con- tinuation of Shrine, am up to page 178 O! what a change! Yesterday in convulsions and under hypadermics she was deformed and swolen, her head seemed ready to burst, and rash covered her face and neck - black and blue; To-day her fearful struggle is over and reposes in triumph as a beautiful child of fifteen. -- a joy to behold. Thanks be to God for her cross and for her evident victory.

regions.cleaned_text: Saturday, 9th 11 A.M. quiet after restless night and morning - about 8 convulsions. At. 12 Sleeps, 12.30 much improved - seemingly asleep, but smiles at remarks of Fr. S. to nurse. Then, seeing her conscious Fr. S. whispers: "That is right Veronica. Keep smiling and God bless you in your better moments ask Jesus to strengthen you in resig- nation to this cross." She whispers the answer, nodding with a little smile, "I do ask Him."
